we have demonstrated that magnetic nanoparticles can be precipitated in the presence of an external magnetic field, and that the orientation of the easy axes in the sample depends on the direction of the applied external field.

the precipitation of a colloidal solution of nanoparticles in the direction of an external magnetic field produces a preferential orientation of the easy axes, compared to the case when the precipitation is carried out without an external field.

we have shown that the magnetic anisotropies of two different samples of immobilized magnetic nanoparticles, one with randomly oriented easy axes and one with preferentially aligned easy axis, are significantly different.

the synthesis and investigation of precipitates of magnetic nanoparticles with different orientations of easy axes.
